name: blocks_in_bin_astra_v1
note: Freeze with `scripts/evaluate_planner.py freeze` before the final split is run. After freezing, a change may only tighten a check, and needs a dated entry in `changes` saying why.

final_state.note: Common grade for every policy type, read from each runner's per-step recording. Footprint from RoboLab assets/fixtures/grey_bin.usd (42 x 28 cm, 10.5 cm rim, origin at the base centre).

screen.rule: The first 3 development seeds. A model must pass at least 2 to earn a full development run.

development.rule: All 10 development seeds. A model must pass at least 7 before it is considered for the final split.

final.rule: The 30 reserved final seeds, run once on a frozen acceptance file and a committed planner.
